title: Agent part-matching output group
description: One proposed equivalence group. Field order in JSON does not matter; scoring only requires members[].

group_id.description: Optional stable id for the group.

canonical_name.description: Agent's standardized name for the real part (for human review).

category.description: Agent's inferred part category (for human review).

confidence.description: Agent confidence that all members are the same real part.

members.description: Rows the agent believes are the same real part.

row_id.description: Exact value in that file's own id column (part_id/Material/SKU/STK_NO/ITEM_CODE/sku).

prices.description: Optional per-member price snapshot for the pricing-difference task.
